title: A Capitulation Direction Emerges With Scale and Is Causally Load-Bearing Where Validation Is Strong: Eight Models, Two Families, and Five Measurement Hazards
summary: Across eight instruction-tuned models, a capitulation direction passed the study’s validation gate at selected larger model sizes; ablating it reduced reversal of correct answers in Qwen2.5-7B. Results are protocol- and model-specific.
ai_technology: Residual-stream linear probing and causal ablation
